property_summary: For any target address and value, if the target's fallback/receive reverts when called, the reference contract's sendMoney call will revert (leaving funds in the contract) while the mutant will not revert and will instead report success; thus the reference always reverts on a failing callee but the mutant sometimes does not.
change_summary: Make sendMoney send the value to _target via call but do not revert on failure (remove revert), causing differing state when call fails.
